Hostage pizza bites.d: Sixteen thin dough rounds with tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked crisp underneath.

Brooklyn potato knishes.d: Mashed with butter-softened onion and white pepper, wrapped in flaky dough, baked golden. Hot mustard.

Manhattan steak sandwich.d: Seared hard, sliced thin, with slow-cooked onions, arugula and horseradish cream on toasted bread.

Rainbow cookies.d: Three almond layers, green, white and red, apricot jam between, dark chocolate on top.

Negotiator's espresso orange tonic.d: A double shot over ice, tonic water and an orange slice. Stir before you sip.
